mapper.select: SELECT id, work_id, table_name, table_info, order_num, created_at, updated_at FROM work_dbtables WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_dbtables (work_id, table_name, table_info, order_num, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workId}, #{tableName}, #{tableInfo}, #{orderNum}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE work_dbtables SET table_name = #{tableName}, table_info = #{tableInfo}, order_num = #{orderNum}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
